description:
Fully renovated and painted 2 bedroom large, warm and spacy boutique apartment situated in the Centre of Manorhamilton !
ONE MEN required - strictly no smoker. A  Desk for an office work provided and the place is suitable for distance work. No pets allowed.

Excellent quiet location in the heart of the town, located within close proximity of all amenities including shops, restaurants, churches, schools. Super Value - 1 minute away. 

It takes 20 minutes drive from Sligo. Also Public transport nearby providing services to Sligo & Enniskillen. Warm apartment - energy rating-B2. 

Accommodation comprises of the following: open plan style kitchen, dining area & living room, storage cupboard & hot-press in hall, 2 Bedrooms & bathroom. Bins included. All mains services connected with electric storage heaters, uPVC double glazed windows.
Off-street free parking to rear of building.

Looking for a non smoker . Licensee for a short term are welcome. No pets allowed.
€1100 Rent Monthly Payment + Deposit in advance
